title: Asset Inventory
description: A compact inventory enriched from authorized NetOps evidence. Active scans run only after an operator explicitly starts one.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Hostname, IP, MAC, vendor, or OS

insights.title: Asset Insights
insights.compactHint: Expand summaries and filter the inventory
insights.empty: Evidence-backed summaries will appear when normalized evidence is available.

detail.title: Asset details
detail.confidenceHelp: Confidence in OS classification based on available network evidence. Private or randomized MAC evidence lowers confidence where applicable.
detail.vendorHelp: Vendor is estimated from MAC and other available device evidence. Some devices may remain Unknown.
detail.noServices: No bounded port or service evidence is available.
detail.noLinks: No related NetOps destination is available for this asset yet.

integrations.title: Operational context
integrations.description: Existing NetOps domains remain separate and authoritative for this asset.

snmp.title: Managed SNMP
snmp.linkedDescription: Open the associated managed target in the SNMP workspace.
snmp.unlinkedDescription: This asset has no current managed SNMP target association.

health.title: Health Watch
health.monitoredDescription: Reachability remains managed by the existing Health Watch target.
health.unmonitoredDescription: This asset has no current Health Watch target association.

inspector.title: Device Inspector
inspector.description: Run the existing bounded Inspector with this asset's current saved IP context.
inspector.inventoryRequired: Save this asset as a device inventory node before inspection.
inspector.operatorRequired: Operator or administrator access is required to run inspection.
inspector.runnerUnavailable: No capable Device Inspector runner is currently available.

history.title: History
history.unavailable: Asset change history is temporarily unavailable.
history.empty: No meaningful changes have been recorded for this asset.

empty.title: No assets match this view
empty.description: Clear the filters or wait until an authorized integration adds inventory records.

unconfigured.title: Asset Inventory is not configured
unconfigured.description: The local PostgreSQL asset connection has not been enabled on this environment.

unavailable.title: Asset Inventory is unavailable
unavailable.description: The local backend could not load the inventory. Existing NetOps features remain unaffected.

quick.title: Quick Discovery
quick.description: Find active devices and basic network identity.

deep.title: Deep Inventory Scan
deep.description: Find devices and enrich OS, ports, services, vendor, and device type.

scan.unavailable: The network scanner is not available on the NetOps host.
scan.stateUnavailable: Scanner status is temporarily unavailable; Asset Inventory remains usable.
scan.noEnabledNetworks: No scan network is enabled. Configure Scan Networks before starting a scan.

errors.SCAN_ALREADY_RUNNING: Another inventory scan is already running.
errors.SCAN_NETWORK_NOT_ALLOWED: The selected network is not allowed.
errors.SCAN_NETWORK_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE: The selected network route is unavailable.
errors.ASSET_SCAN_FAILED: The scan request could not be completed safely.

scanNetworks.title: Scan Networks
scanNetworks.description: Manage directly connected or routed private networks that may be scanned. Connectivity testing checks only the kernel route and does not scan hosts.

detected.title: Detected Networks
detected.empty: No directly connected private network was detected.
detected.unavailable: Automatic network detection is unavailable. You can still add a private network manually.

configured.title: Configured Networks
configured.empty: No scan network has been configured.

add.title: Add Network
add.help: Use the same form for directly connected or routed networks. Enter a canonical network CIDR, not a host address.
add.name: Name

scanNetworks.deleteConfirm: Delete network {{network}}? Environment bootstrap will not recreate this configuration.

routeFeedback.direct: A direct route is available for {{cidr}}.
routeFeedback.routed: A routed path is available for {{cidr}}.
routeFeedback.unreachable: No route is currently available for {{cidr}}. It can be saved disabled.
routeFeedback.unknown: The route for {{cidr}} cannot currently be inspected. Manual configuration can still be saved disabled.

errors.INVALID_SCAN_NETWORK: Enter a valid canonical private IPv4 network CIDR.
errors.SCAN_NETWORK_PUBLIC: Only private RFC1918 IPv4 networks are allowed.
errors.SCAN_NETWORK_TOO_BROAD: The network is too broad; use /22 or narrower.
errors.INVALID_SCAN_NETWORK_NAME: The network name is invalid or too long.
errors.SCAN_NETWORK_LIMIT_REACHED: The limit of eight configured networks has been reached.
errors.SCAN_NETWORK_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE: The network cannot be enabled until a route is available.
errors.SCAN_NETWORKS_UNAVAILABLE: Scan network settings are temporarily unavailable.
